items.evidence: Log shows 48 separate pick-up/drop cycles for the P1000, each aspirating 250 uL from a distinct tube (slot 10 then slot 7) into a distinct odd-column well, and the same well position is carried through to the elution plate.

Log lines 24-746 give 40 uL beads, then 250 uL isopropanol (2x125), then 250 uL sample with 5 mixes of 400 uL; then delay 300 s, engage, delay 240 s, and 3x180 uL supernatant removed to waste plate per column with the magnet on.
Two ethanol washes of 3x166.667 uL (500 uL) added and fully removed with the magnet engaged (log 817-1059), then delay 240 s and disengage before elution.
The agent recovers 90 uL (log 1210-1231: aspirate 90 uL) rather than about 80 uL, although 100 uL was added off-magnet and mixed, with 30 s then engage and 90 s delay and a 4 C elution plate.

The step order follows the paper (beads, isopropanol, sample, 5 min, magnet 4 min, 2 ethanol washes, 4 min dry, elution, 30 s, 90 s) and the reagent labels are accurate; the only additions are a bead pre-mix and a 10x elution resuspension.

judge.summary: The protocol faithfully executes binding, separation, two ethanol washes and drying with correct volumes, delays and magnet states per the simulator log. It fails the elution recovery item because it recovers 90 uL instead of about 80 uL.
